title: Associated points on an affine open and associated primes of sections
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $F$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], and let $W=\operatorname{Spec}R\subseteq X$ be an affine open [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-open-immersion]. Put $M=\Gamma(W,F)$. For $x\in W$, let $\mathfrak p\subset R$ be its corresponding prime ideal. Associated primes mean element-annihilator primes [def-weil-pbc-annihilator-associated-primes], and associated points mean [def-trf-relative-assassin]. If $\mathfrak p\in\operatorname{Ass}_R(M)$, then $x\in\operatorname{Ass}_X(F)$. Conversely, if $x\in\operatorname{Ass}_X(F)$ and the ideal $\mathfrak p$ is finitely generated, then $\mathfrak p\in\operatorname{Ass}_R(M)$. In particular, when $R$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $x\in\operatorname{Ass}_X(F)$ if and only if $\mathfrak p\in\operatorname{Ass}_R(M)$. No finite-generation hypothesis on $M$ is required.

source.place: Tag 02OK (lemma-associated-affine-open), both implications and their Noetherian consequence.

proof.text: Use [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-stalk-localization] and [lem-sbc-affine-module-germ-localization] to identify the ring and module germ maps with $R\to R_{\mathfrak p}$ and $M\to M_{\mathfrak p}$. The module identification respects the localized ring action: a scalar $a/s$ acts as $a$ followed by the inverse of multiplication by $s$. By [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] the maximal ideal is $\mathfrak pR_{\mathfrak p}$. Thus [def-trf-relative-assassin] identifies association of $x$ with this ideal being the annihilator of an element of $M_{\mathfrak p}$.

source.place: Tag 02OK (lemma-associated-affine-open), proof; Algebra Tag 0310 (lemma-associated-primes-localize), finite-generator proof.

proof.text: If $\mathfrak p\in\operatorname{Ass}_R(M)$, [lem-weil-pbc-associated-prime-localize-at-prime] gives $\mathfrak pR_{\mathfrak p}\in\operatorname{Ass}_{R_{\mathfrak p}}(M_{\mathfrak p})$ in the element-annihilator sense, without a Noetherian assumption. Step 1 gives $x\in\operatorname{Ass}_X(F)$.

source.place: Tag 02OK (lemma-associated-affine-open), proof; Algebra Tag 0310 (lemma-associated-primes-localize), finite-generator proof.

proof.text:
Conversely let $x$ be associated and write an annihilator witness from step 1 as $w=m/f$ with $f
otin\mathfrak p$. Since $f/1$ is a unit, $m/1$ has the same annihilator as $w$. Choose generators $a_1,\ldots,a_n$ of $\mathfrak p$. Each $(a_i m)/1=0$, so [def-weil-pbc-module-localization] gives $s_i
otin\mathfrak p$ with $s_i a_i m=0$. Put $s=\prod_i s_i$ and $z=sm$. Primality gives $s
otin\mathfrak p$, and every generator kills $z$, hence $\mathfrak p z=0$. For $n=0$ use the empty product $s=1$.

source.place: Tag 02OK (lemma-associated-affine-open), proof; Algebra Tag 0310 (lemma-associated-primes-localize), finite-generator proof.

proof.text: If $az=0$, localization gives $(a/1)(s/1)(m/1)=0$. Cancel the unit $s/1$ to obtain $a/1\in\mathfrak pR_{\mathfrak p}$. This forces $a\in\mathfrak p$: membership means $a/1=b/t$ with $b\in\mathfrak p$, $t\notin\mathfrak p$; the fraction equality yields $u(ta-b)=0$ with $u\notin\mathfrak p$, so $uta\in\mathfrak p$ and primality implies $a\in\mathfrak p$. Together with step 3 this proves $\operatorname{Ann}_R(z)=\mathfrak p$, the required witness by [def-weil-pbc-annihilator-associated-primes].

source.place: Tag 02OK (lemma-associated-affine-open), proof; Algebra Tag 0310 (lemma-associated-primes-localize), finite-generator proof.

proof.text: If $R$ is Noetherian, [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] says every ideal, in particular $\mathfrak p$, is finitely generated. Apply the two implications. At no point was finite generation of $M$ used.

source.place: Tag 02OK (lemma-associated-affine-open), proof; Algebra Tag 0310 (lemma-associated-primes-localize), finite-generator proof.

lean.statement: theorem affine_associated_points_primes {X : Scheme.{u}} (F : X.Modules) (hqc : F.IsQuasicoherent) (W : X.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (x : W) : ((hW.primeIdealOf x).asIdeal ∈ RingTheory.annihilatorAssociatedPrimes (X.presheaf.obj (op W)) (F.val.obj (op W)) → (x : X) ∈ associatedPoints F) ∧ ((x : X) ∈ associatedPoints F → (hW.primeIdealOf x).asIdeal.FG → (hW.primeIdealOf x).asIdeal ∈ RingTheory.annihilatorAssociatedPrimes (X.presheaf.obj (op W)) (F.val.obj (op W))) ∧ (IsNoetherianRing (X.presheaf.obj (op W)) → ((x : X) ∈ associatedPoints F ↔ (hW.primeIdealOf x).asIdeal ∈ RingTheory.annihilatorAssociatedPrimes (X.presheaf.obj (op W)) (F.val.obj (op W))))

reviewed_lean.note: Statement matches node and Stacks 02OK clause by clause: arbitrary Scheme.{u}; F : X.Modules with IsQuasicoherent only; W affine open, R = Γ(X,W), M = F.val.obj (op W); p = (hW.primeIdealOf x).asIdeal; forward implication unconditional, converse with FG on p only, iff under IsNoetherianRing R; no finiteness on M. Ass = RingTheory.annihilatorAssociatedPrimes (00LA element annihilator, not Mathlib radical version); associatedPoints = def-trf-relative-assassin record (02OJ). Edge cases (empty W, F=0, p=0, infinite-rank, non-Noetherian) covered.
